html:
This week COVID (SARS-CoV-2) continues to account for about 1\% of emergency department (ED) visits of Douglas County residents. ED visits related to influenza and respiratory sysncytial virus (RSV) are low.

Both COVID and influenza A virus levels in sampled wastewater in Lawrence are elevated compared to their summertime lows. Levels of respiratory RSV and influenza B continue to be low.
